takeaway: The lungs are invested in visceral pleura; parietal pleura coats the chest wall. The right main bronchus is shorter and wider. The arterial supply is mainly via the bronchial arteries.

lines.text: Which statement about the lungs is correct? Let us check each one.
The lungs are invested in visceral pleura, not parietal pleura.
Parietal pleura coats the chest wall.
The right main bronchus is wider, shorter and more vertical than the left, so it is not longer.
lines.say: (clears throat) The right main bronchus is wider, shorter and more vertical than the left, so it is not longer.

lines.text: The arterial blood supply is mainly via the bronchial arteries,
with a small amount of oxygenation from the pulmonary artery.
So the correct statement: the bronchial arteries supply the lung with oxygenated blood.
